column1: # hexSamples is up to 256 evenly-spaced RGBA8 pixels (see AvifFfmpegReferenceBaseline's remarks for why a sample, not a whole-buffer hash) from ffmpeg's independent AVIF decoder (libdav1d). Regenerate with PEACHIMAGE_AVIF_FFMPEG_BASELINE=write dotnet test --filter AvifFfmpegReferenceTests (requires ffmpeg/ffprobe with libdav1d on PATH), then review the diff.
